biomarkers.name: Plasma EBV DNA
biomarkers.clinical_use: Widely used in endemic settings (Hong Kong, southern China): population screening (Chan et al. NEJM 2017), staging refinement, treatment response monitoring, and MRD detection. Baseline high EBV DNA and non-clearance post-treatment predict relapse.

biomarkers.name: EBER (in situ hybridisation)
biomarkers.prevalence: Nearly 100% in endemic non-keratinizing EBV-associated NPC; much less frequent in keratinizing NPC

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS)
biomarkers.prevalence: Frequently expressed; reported in a substantial proportion of NPCs, but assay/cutoff-dependent rather than uniformly ~90%
biomarkers.clinical_use: Anti-PD-1 agents (including toripalimab and camrelizumab in NPC, with pembrolizumab/nivolumab showing activity) are active in R/M NPC; PD-L1 expression is common but not a definitive standalone selection biomarker in NPC.

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 amplification (9p24.1)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Reported in a subset; may associate with immune checkpoint sensitivity, but not an established routine clinical biomarker in NPC

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Non-keratinizing carcinoma (differentiated or undifferentiated); undifferentiated variant classical 'lymphoepithelioma-like'
variants: keratinizing SCC (more common in non-endemic populations)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Traditional WHO classification: keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma, non-keratinizing carcinoma (differentiated), and non-keratinizing carcinoma (undifferentiated); the non-keratinizing undifferentiated type predominates in endemic areas

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Highly inflamed / 'hot' — dense lymphocytic infiltrate is characteristic ('lymphoepithelioma')
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Rich lymphoplasmacytic stroma; syncytial epithelial nests intermixed with lymphocytes

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Nasopharyngeal epithelial cells (classically arising in the fossa of Rosenmüller region)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Non-keratinizing (differentiated or undifferentiated); 'lymphoepithelioma-like' in endemic EBV-driven form
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Distinct lineage biology from other UAT SCCs — EBV establishes latency in nasopharyngeal epithelium
